text:
I got tired of my coding CLIs drifting out of date.

AI Tools Maintainer is a Grok Bot that runs weekday mornings, updates only the tools I already installed, and stays quiet if nothing changed.

Setup and the first-message prompt are in the article. https://t.co/nvtl3fvBHe
